name: Yifan Sun
tagline: Nonlinear photonics · cavity solitons · Kerr resonators
lede: I am a postdoctoral researcher at OPERA-Photonique, Université libre de Bruxelles, working on cavity solitons, frequency combs and noise in nonlinear optical resonators.
thesis: I study how light organises itself into pulses that hold their shape for billions of round trips inside a resonator.
